title_zh: 拉萨市举办劳动用工规范化专项培训555家企业代表集中“充电”
title_en: Lhasa Holds Special Training on Labor Standardization, 555 Enterprise Representatives Attend
summary_zh: 7月30日，拉萨市举办劳动用工规范化专项培训，555家企业代表参加，旨在提升企业劳动用工管理水平。
summary_en: On July 30, Lhasa held a special training on labor standardization, attended by 555 enterprise representatives to improve labor management.
